DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ごめんなさい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 連絡くれてた？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: さっきね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 忙しかった？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 訓練中だったから見てなくて……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 急ぎ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 何か用だった？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 明日、百鬼夜行に行くんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 百花繚乱との協力についても相談させて欲しいんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 明日……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いいけど……私で大丈夫なの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……大丈夫って？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 百花繚乱の大事なことを

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私が決めていいのかな……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今の百花繚乱の代表は誰だっけ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……そうだった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まだ慣れないんだよね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃ、また明日

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 聞いたんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今週末のお祭りに来るの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、多分ね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 商人会から誘われたんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そうなんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私も呼ばれてて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 手伝いに行くから

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ナグサは何を手伝うの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 屋台で焼き鳥を焼くことになってる

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 人手が足りないんだって

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ナグサの焼き鳥！楽しみだね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 他にもいろんな屋台が出るみたい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 楽しいお祭りになるといいんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もちろん、先生にとっても

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ありがとう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 打ち上げ、参加させてもらえた

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: いい写真だね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生の言った通りだった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 正直に話したら、みんな喜んでくれて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: でも、最後はみんな大笑いしてて……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 何が面白かったんだろう……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: なんて言ったの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: クールな美少女に見えても、実際はそうじゃないから……って

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 自分で思ってるより、ナグサは面白い人だと思うよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 面白い？私が……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 気のせいかもしれないけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 最近、夜間のトラブルが増えた気がする

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 百花繚乱も大変だね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ナグサも夜道には気をつけるんだよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 大丈夫

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: これが私たちの役割だし

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 夜はあんまり人、いないし。夜目は利くほうだから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: でも、問題が起きたら面倒だし

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: しばらくは夜のパトロールを増やした方が良さそう

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今日は仕事の目途がつきそうなんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: よかったら私も行っていい？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そう？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ、また後で

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 雪女って知ってる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 美人な妖怪として描かれることが多いんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: なんでなんだろう？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 細かい理由はいろいろあると思うけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 分かりやすく、目を引きやすいからじゃない？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: たしかに

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 人をだますなら美人の方が便利だよね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……もし私が妖怪だったら、大妖怪になってたかも

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: その意気やよし！

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아, 선생님.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 미안. 혹시 연락했었어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 안녕, 나구사!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 응. 많이 바빴던 모양이네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 훈련 중이라 잠시 핸드폰을 다른 곳에 두고 있었거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그보다 무슨 급한 일이라도…?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 혹시 내 도움이 필요한 일이 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 급한 일은 아니고, 내일 백귀야행에 잠깐 방문할 예정이거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그때 백화요란의 협력 업무에 관해 잠깐 논의할 수 있을까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 내일……?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 시간을 내는 건 어렵지 않지만, 내가 해도 괜찮을까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: ……뭐가?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아무것도 아닌 내가

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 백화요란의 중요한 업무를 결정해도 괜찮을지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 무슨 소리야. 지금 백화요란의 대표는 나구사잖아?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 미안. 자꾸 잊어버리게 되네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 알겠어. 그럼 내일 보자. 기다리고 있을게.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 혹시 이번 주 주말에 백귀야행에서 열리는 골목 상가 축제에 올 예정 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 특별한 일이 없으면 갈 것 같네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 안 그래도 상인회에서 한 번 와 달라는 부탁을 받았거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그렇구나.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그럼, 그때 잠깐 볼 수 있을지도 모르겠네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 상인들의 부탁으로 나도 축제를 도우러 갈 예정이었거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 나구사는 축제에서 무슨 역할을 맡았는데?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 나는… 노점상에서 꼬치구이를 구울 예정이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 음식을 준비하는 데 손이 모자란다고 해서.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 나구사가 직접 굽는 꼬치구이라니, 기대가 되는걸!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그 외에도 여러 가지 길거리 음식을 파는 모양인가 봐.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 모두에게 즐거운 축제가 되었으면 좋겠네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그럼 선생님도 즐거운 축제를 즐기길.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 고마워, 선생님.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 덕분에 상점가 사람들과 즐겁게 이야기하고 왔어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 재미있게 놀다 온 모양이네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 응

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님의 말처럼 솔직하게 이야기했더니 다들 좋아해 주었어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그런데 내 말이 끝나자마자 다들 박장대소를 해서

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 결국 어떤 점이 재미있었는지는 알기 어려웠지만.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 뭐라고 말했는데?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 내가 다가가기 어려운, 신비롭고 쿨한 인상의 미소녀처럼 보이더라도 부디 편히 대해 달라고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 나구사.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 넌 스스로 생각하는 것보다 본인이 훨씬 재미있는 사람이라는 걸 알아야 해.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그런가……?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 요즈음은 기분 탓인지

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 해가 진 어두운 때에 말썽을 부리는 망량즈가 늘어난 것 같아

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 날이 더워진 탓이려나?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 불량 학생들도 더위는 어쩔 수 없을 테니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……그럴지도 모르겠네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그 외에도 밤 중에는 지켜보는 사람이 적으니까

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어둠을 틈타 나쁜 일을 저지르기도 좋지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 당분간은 야간 순찰 빈도를 조금 늘려보려 해

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어두운 밤에 위험한 장난을 치다 다치는 학생이 나오면 곤란하니까

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 백화요란도 고생이 많네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 나구사도 어두운 밤길은 조심해야 해.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 괜찮아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이래 봬도 밤눈은 꽤 밝은 편이거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 설녀의 이야기를 들어본 적 있어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어느 설화에나 설녀는 미녀로 그려지는 경우가 많던데……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 특별한 이유라도 있는 걸까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 여러 가지 이유가 있겠지만……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 눈길을 끌기 쉬워서가 아닐까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 확실히, 그럴지도 모르겠네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 시선을 쉽게 끄는 매력적인 외모의 소유자가 아니라면 어떤 함정을 파 놓는다 하더라도 행인이 쉽게 걸려들지 않을 테니까

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그런 의미에서 나는 요괴가 되지 않아서 다행이라고 생각해

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 자신감 넘치는 그 태도 보기 좋습니다

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ah. Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Apologies. You called?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Hi, Nagusa! I did!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You must've been busy!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I did not bring my phone with me to training.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Anyways, is there a matter of concern?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Do you require my assistance?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Nothing urgent! I'm visiting Hyakkiyako tomorrow!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Let's discuss our collaboration with the Hyakkaryouran tomorrow!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Tomorrow...?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I could clear some time, but is that...truly okay?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Is what okay?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I am nobody.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It would not be right for me to make decisions for the Hyakkaryouran.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Huh? Nagusa! You're the Hyakkaryouran's representative!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ah.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Apologies. I forgot again.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Understood. I shall await our meeting tomorrow.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: There is a Market Alley Festival being held in Hyakkiyako this weekend. Will you attend?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Barring work, I'll be there!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: The merchant guild asked me to be there!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I see.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Then perhaps our paths will cross.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The merchants requested my assistance.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Awesome! What're you going to be doing?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I will be...grilling skewers at a food stall.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: They're apparently lacking in cooking staff.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Oooh! Nagusa-grilled skewers! I need some!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: They'll be selling a large variety of street food.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I have high hopes that it will be an invigorating festival for all.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And I hope you enjoy yourself as well, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thanks to your efforts, I had an enjoyable time speaking with people in the shopping district.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Sounds like it was a lot of fun!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I spoke from the heart, as you directed, and my words were well-received.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: In fact, they all burst into laughter as I spoke.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Even though I did not tell a joke.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What did you say?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I may appear to be a mysterious, cool, unapproachable beauty, but please treat me as you would anyone else.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Nagusa.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You're actually a very funny person. Did you know that?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Is...that so?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I may be imagining things

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: however it would appear the Mouryo have been operating at night, as of late.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Maybe because it's been so hot!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Not even they can cause trouble in the heat!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...Perhaps.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The streets echo abandoned under the moon's light as well,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: allowing them to carry out their illicit activities with ease.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: To combat this, I intend to increase the frequency of night patrols.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: We cannot allow a student to harm themselves during the dark of night.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: The Hyakkaryouran sure has it rough.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You have to be careful too, Nagusa!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Worry not.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: My nighttime vision is excellent.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, have you yet heard tales of the snow maiden?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: She is depicted as a blossoming beauty in many a folklore tale.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I am curious as to why she's described that way.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: A lot of reasons...but I can think of one in particular.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Maybe because "beauty" tends to draw people's attention?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Because "beauty" is appealing... I see.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: People will not fall for a trap with no honey. As such, a "blossoming beauty" would be an appropriate lure.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I find myself grateful that I am not a youkai.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I like that confidence!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ๊ะ คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอโทษนะ ติดต่อเข้ามาหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: สวัสดี นางุสะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ กำลังยุ่งมากเลยสินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันกำลังฝึกซ้อมอยู่ ก็เลยวาง
โทรศัพท์ไว้ที่อื่นน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ว่าแต่มีเรื่องด่วนอะไรงั้นเหรอ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หรืออยากให้ฉันช่วยอะไรหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่ใช่เรื่องด่วนหรอก แค่พรุ่งนี้ครู
จะแวะไปเฮียกคิยาโคเดี๋ยวหนึ่งน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ขอคุยเรื่องงานความร่วมมือกับ
เฮียกกะเรียวรันหน่อยได้มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: พรุ่งนี้เหรอ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันก็หาเวลาให้ได้หรอกนะ แต่ว่าจะ
คุยกับฉันได้เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ทำไมล่ะ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็ฉันไม่ใช่คนสำคัญอะไร

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันจะตัดสินใจเรื่องงานสำคัญของ
เฮียกกะเรียวรันได้หรือเปล่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
พูดอะไรน่ะ ตอนนี้ตัวแทนของ
เฮียกกะเรียวรันคือนางุสะนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอโทษนะ ฉันลืมอยู่เรื่อยเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เข้าใจแล้ว งั้นเจอกันพรุ่งนี้นะ
แล้วฉันจะรอ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครูจะมาเทศกาลตรอกการค้าที่จะ
จัดในเฮียกคิยาโคสุดสัปดาห์นี้หรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าไม่มีงานอะไร ครูก็น่าจะไปนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
กลุ่มการค้าก็มาขอให้ครูไปร่วมงาน
เหมือนกัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อย่างนั้นสินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้นเราอาจจะได้เจอกันก็ได้นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
พวกพ่อค้าก็ขอให้ฉันไปช่วยในงาน
เทศกาลเหมือนกันน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
นางุสะต้องทำอะไรในงาน
เทศกาลเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉัน... จะไปช่วยย่างอาหารเสียบไม้ที่
ร้านริมถนน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: พอดีทางนั้นบอกว่ามีคนไม่พอน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ของย่างเสียบไม้ฝีมือนางุสะงั้นเหรอ
ครูจะตั้งตารอเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
น่าจะมีอาหารอย่างอื่นขายอีกหลาย
อย่างเลยละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
หวังว่าจะเป็นเทศกาลที่ทุกคนได้สนุก
กันนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้างั้นคุณครูเองก็สนุกกับงานเทศกาล
ด้วยเหมือนกันนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอบคุณนะ คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันพูดคุยกับคนในย่านการค้าสนุกมาก
เลยละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ได้ไปกินเลี้ยงสนุกเลยสินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
พอฉันพูดอย่างตรงไปตรงมาตามที่
คุณครูแนะนำ ทุกคนก็พากันชอบใจน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่พอฉันพูดจบ ทุกคนก็ปรบมือ
แล้วก็หัวเราะลั่นเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
จนฉันไม่รู้ว่าพวกเขาตลกกับตรงไหน
ที่ฉันพูดกันแน่

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: พูดไปว่าอะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันบอกไปว่าต่อให้ฉันจะดูเหมือนสาว
สวยสุดคูลที่ดูลึกลับและเข้าถึงยาก
แต่ก็ให้ทำตัวตามสบายกับฉันได้เลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: นางุสะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
นางุสะต้องรู้นะว่าตัวเองเป็นคนตลก
เฮฮามากกว่าที่คิดน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นเหรอ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หมู่นี้ไม่รู้ฉันคิดไปเองหรือเปล่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
หลังจากพระอาทิตย์ตก เหมือนพวก
ปีศาจจะออกมาก่อปัญหากันเยอะขึ้นเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ออกมาข้างนอกกันเยอะเพราะอากาศ
ร้อนหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ถึงจะเป็นเด็กเกเร แต่ก็น่าจะทน
อากาศร้อนไม่ได้หรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็อาจจะเป็นอย่างนั้นก็ได้...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ตอนกลางคืนก็มีคนออกไปตรวจตรา
กันน้อยด้วย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าคิดจะทำอะไรไม่ดี ตอนมืดค่ำดึกดื่น
ก็ถือว่าเหมาะเลยละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันก็เลยจะออกไปลาดตระเวนตอน
กลางคืนให้ถี่กว่าเดิมหน่อยน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้ามีนักเรียนบาดเจ็บจากการเล่นอะไร
แผลงๆ ตอนกลางคืนละยุ่งเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
เฮียกกะเรียวรันก็เหนื่อยไม่แพ้กัน
เลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ตอนกลางคืนนางุสะก็ระวังตัวด้วยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่เป็นไรหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เห็นฉันอย่างนี้ ตอนกลางคืนฉันตาดี
มากนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู เคยได้ยินเรื่องของหญิงหิมะ
หรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ในนิทานพื้นบ้าน หญิงหิมะมักถูก
พรรณาว่าเป็นหญิงงาม...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มีเหตุผลอะไรเป็นพิเศษหรือเปล่านะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ก็คงมีหลายๆ เหตุผลน่ะนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
แต่เพราะน่าจะดึงดูดสายตาผู้คนได้
ง่ายหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อาจจะเป็นอย่างนั้นก็ได้นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าไม่มีรูปลักษณ์ที่ดึงดูดความสนใจ
ได้ง่าย ไม่ว่าจะวางกับดักอะไรไว้
ผู้คนที่ผ่านไปมาก็คงไม่ติดกับง่ายๆ หรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ในแง่นั้น ฉันคิดว่าโชคดีแล้วละที่ฉัน
ไม่ได้กลายเป็นปีศาจหรืออะไรพวกนั้นไป

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูชอบที่นางุสะมีความมั่นใจ
เต็มเปี่ยมแบบนี้จัง

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊，老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不好意思，你剛剛有找我嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗨，名草！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，看來你最近很忙呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我剛才在訓練，所以把手機放在旁邊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 有什麼急事嗎……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 還是需要我幫忙？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 沒有什麼急事，只是我明天打算去一趟百鬼夜行

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 想說能不能聊一下百花繚亂的合作業務

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 明天……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 時間方面倒不成問題，但由我來真的可以嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……怎麼說呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我只是覺得像我這種不值一提的人

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 決定百花繚亂的重要業務真的沒問題嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 怎麼會，現在百花繚亂的代表可是名草你哦？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 抱歉，我總是會忘記

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼明天見。我會等你來的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 你這週末會來百鬼夜行舉辦的商店街慶典嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 沒意外的話應該會過去哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 正好商會也希望我能過去一趟

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 原來如此

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼到時候或許能見到面呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我也因為商會的請託，要去協助慶典

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 名草會在慶典中負責什麼呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我……會在攤位上烤串燒

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 因為準備食物的人手不夠

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 名草親手烤的串燒，好期待！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 到時候似乎還會賣各種小吃

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 希望大家都能玩得開心

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師也要好好享受慶典哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 謝謝你，老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 多虧有你的幫忙，我和商店街的人聊得很開心

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 看來你玩得很愉快呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗯

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 就像老師說的一樣，我坦白說出心裡的想法之後，大家都很高興

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不過才剛說完，大家就笑成了一團

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我到最後還是不知道哪裡好笑

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 你說了什麼呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 就算我看起來是個難以親近的神祕冷酷美少女，大家也可以輕鬆對待我沒關係

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 名草

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我覺得你比自己想像中還要有趣得多哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是嗎……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不知道是不是我的錯覺

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 最近在天黑後鬧事的妖怪劇團好像變多了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 可能是因為天氣變熱的關係吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 畢竟就連不良學生也沒辦法對抗炎熱啊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……或許是吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 況且夜裡看守的人比較少

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 要摸黑做壞事也更容易

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以我打算暫時增加夜間巡邏的頻率

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不然要是有人因為晚上的惡作劇受傷就麻煩了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 百花繚亂真辛苦呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 名草你也要小心哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 沒事的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 其實我的夜視力意外的還不錯哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，你聽過雪女的故事嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 在故事裡面，雪女大多被描繪成美女……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 有什麼特別的原因嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 原因應該有很多……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 可能是因為比較容易吸引目光吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 確實有可能

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果缺少能吸引目光的魅力外貌，無論設下什麼陷阱都很難讓人輕易中招吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 從這個角度來看，我沒變成妖怪真是太好了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 充滿自信的態度很不錯哦
